panels.title: Peak detector — predicted vs realized
panels.description: Whole-home grid power (15-min mean, InfluxDB) with the optimizer's predicted capacity-peak slots overlaid as red bands and the predicted peak threshold as a dashed line. Scoreline on top: a past predicted slot counts as a hit when it lands in the realized top-K 15-min draws of the visible window (K = number of predicted slots already past); misses = top-K draws that were not predicted, false alarms = past predicted slots outside the top-K. Peak-slot data since 2026-07-03 (v0.2.0) — until predictions age past their slot time the bands sit in the future and no score can be computed. Grid power history in InfluxDB starts 2026-06-28.

panels.title: Frozen forecast vs realized — InfluxDB (long history)
Frozen forecast vs realized — critical load (hourly kWh)
panels.description: InfluxDB, unlimited retention (unlike the Prometheus panels above, ~10d). Realized = zeus_load_history.kwh (hourly critical-load energy). options.content:
### Reserved for the central-vs-in-process parity panels (card #124, P2 checkpoint)

Planned here once the parity checkpoint lands:

- served-forecast delta: jupiter forecast-service vs in-process fit, same cycle / same slots
- parity MAE and worst-slot delta over the soak window
- `zeus_forecast_source` flips and `zeus_forecast_model_age_seconds` during the soak
- backtest-oracle score, once available

**Known instrumentation gaps** (why some #131 panels are absent from this dashboard):

- **Temp-slope drift** (cooling kWh/°C): `TempAwareForecaster` only *logs* its fitted slope — it is not exported to Prometheus or persisted to InfluxDB, so no drift panel is possible yet. Needs a small zeus change (gauge or `zeus_state` field) first.
- **Per-forecaster MAE split** (TempAware / TwoComponent / Baseline): persisted forecasts carry no tag or field identifying which fit served, so rolling error cannot be attributed per forecaster.
- **Whole-home & A/C forecasts are not persisted** — `zeus_forecast` / `zeus_forecast_frozen` carry only the critical-load `load_kwh`, so forecast-vs-realized scoring is critical-load only.

panels.title: Forecaster shadow mode — candidate variants vs persistence_24h and live (#322)
Shadow MAE per variant — critical load (7d solid / 28d dashed)
panels.description: Forecaster SHADOW MODE (#321 / #322, jupiter ADR-0027 §8). Every trainer run (CronJob every 6 h at :17, data since 2026-10-05) records the live model's forecast and each candidate variant's forecast for every target hour of its horizon in jupiter_forecast_shadow (bucket zeus; per-HOUR kWh, never ×4; timestamp = the target hour; lead_h = run-to-target distance bucketed 0/6/12/18/24/30/36 h). Candidates are never served to the lar. This panel: hourly |forecast − realized| per variant, averaged over all lead buckets (every lead weighs the same, so variants are compared on the same mix), then a trailing 7 d (solid) / 28 d (dashed) mean. Realized = the same series as the panels above: zeus_load_history ∪ jupiter_load_history .kwh (hourly critical-load energy). References: live (green, thick) and persistence_24h (red, thick) are always shown; use the legend to isolate a candidate. Lower is better. The 28 d lines are a trailing mean of whatever has accrued — only meaningful once 28 d of shadow data exist. Per-lead breakdown in the table below. PROMOTION RULE (fixed up front): a variant replaces the live model only if, over ≥ 28 days of shadow data, it beats BOTH persistence_24h AND live on BOTH targets (critical_load and whole_home) on MAE, with |bias| no worse than live's. Clock started 2026-10-05; first eligible read 2026-11-03. The two 90-day variants (how_hd_90d_hl15, how_hd_90d_hl7) are recorded but NOT eligible before 2026-11-24 (whole_home) / 2026-12-29 (critical_load) — their history is contaminated by carried-forward and placeholder hours before then (card #323); their 28 days count from those dates. Score formally with jupiter services/forecast/scripts/score_shadow.py.

panels.title: Shadow MAE per variant — whole home (7d solid / 28d dashed)
panels.description: Forecaster SHADOW MODE (#321 / #322, jupiter ADR-0027 §8). Every trainer run (CronJob every 6 h at :17, data since 2026-10-05) records the live model's forecast and each candidate variant's forecast for every target hour of its horizon in jupiter_forecast_shadow (bucket zeus; per-HOUR kWh, never ×4; timestamp = the target hour; lead_h = run-to-target distance bucketed 0/6/12/18/24/30/36 h). Candidates are never served to the lar. This panel: hourly |forecast − realized| per variant, averaged over all lead buckets (every lead weighs the same, so variants are compared on the same mix), then a trailing 7 d (solid) / 28 d (dashed) mean. Realized = the same whole-home definition as the 'Realized load by target' panel: hourly mean grid draw (zeus_grid_power_w history ∪ zeus_state/jupiter_state .grid_power_w, /1000) ≈ kWh/h — grid IMPORT, net of battery/PV flows. References: live (green, thick) and persistence_24h (red, thick) are always shown; use the legend to isolate a candidate. Lower is better. The 28 d lines are a trailing mean of whatever has accrued — only meaningful once 28 d of shadow data exist. Per-lead breakdown in the table below. PROMOTION RULE (fixed up front): a variant replaces the live model only if, over ≥ 28 days of shadow data, it beats BOTH persistence_24h AND live on BOTH targets (critical_load and whole_home) on MAE, with |bias| no worse than live's. Clock started 2026-10-05; first eligible read 2026-11-03. The two 90-day variants (how_hd_90d_hl15, how_hd_90d_hl7) are recorded but NOT eligible before 2026-11-24 (whole_home) / 2026-12-29 (critical_load) — their history is contaminated by carried-forward and placeholder hours before then (card #323); their 28 days count from those dates. Score formally with jupiter services/forecast/scripts/score_shadow.py.

targets.query:
import "experimental"
import "math"
lookback = experimental.subDuration(d: 7d, from: v.timeRangeStart)
sh = from(bucket: "zeus")
  |> range(start: lookback, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "jupiter_forecast_shadow" and r._field == "load_kwh" and r.target == "whole_home")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "variant", "lead_h"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "forecast"})
hist = from(bucket: "zeus")
  |> range(start: lookback, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "zeus_grid_power_w" and r._field == "value")
live = from(bucket: "zeus")
  |> range(start: lookback, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "zeus_state" or r._measurement == "jupiter_state") and r._field == "grid_power_w")
re = union(tables: [hist, live])
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, realized: r._value / 1000.0}))
join(tables: {f: sh, r: re}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, variant: r.variant, _value: math.abs(x: r.forecast - r.realized)}))
  |> group(columns: ["variant"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> timedMovingAverage(every: 1h, period: 7d)
  |> unique(column: "_time")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._time >= v.timeRangeStart)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "variant"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with variant: r.variant + " MAE 7d"}))
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["variant"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Shadow MAE by variant × lead — critical load (selected range)
panels.description: Forecaster SHADOW MODE (#321 / #322, jupiter ADR-0027 §8). Every trainer run (CronJob every 6 h at :17, data since 2026-10-05) records the live model's forecast and each candidate variant's forecast for every target hour of its horizon in jupiter_forecast_shadow (bucket zeus; per-HOUR kWh, never ×4; timestamp = the target hour; lead_h = run-to-target distance bucketed 0/6/12/18/24/30/36 h). Candidates are never served to the lar. This table: MAE per variant × lead bucket over the SELECTED time range (not a trailing window) — which model wins at which horizon. 'all leads' = every lead bucket pooled (the value the rolling-MAE lines converge to over the same range); 'samples' = number of (hour, lead) error samples behind the row — treat rows with few samples as noise. Sorted best-first on 'all leads'. Realized = the same series as the panels above: zeus_load_history ∪ jupiter_load_history .kwh (hourly critical-load energy). Set the dashboard range to ≥ 28 d when reading it against the promotion rule (see the MAE panel).

targets.query:
import "math"
lookback = v.timeRangeStart
sh = from(bucket: "zeus")
  |> range(start: lookback, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "jupiter_forecast_shadow" and r._field == "load_kwh" and r.target == "critical_load")
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "variant", "lead_h"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "forecast"})
re = from(bucket: "zeus")
  |> range(start: lookback, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._measurement == "zeus_load_history" or r._measurement == "jupiter_load_history") and r._field == "kwh")
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, realized: r._value}))
err = join(tables: {f: sh, r: re}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, variant: r.variant, lead_h: r.lead_h, _value: math.abs(x: r.forecast - r.realized)}))
byLead = err
  |> group(columns: ["variant", "lead_h"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({variant: r.variant, lead: "+" + r.lead_h + "h", _value: r._value}))
allLeads = err
  |> group(columns: ["variant"])
  |> mean()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({variant: r.variant, lead: "all leads", _value: r._value}))
samples = err
  |> group(columns: ["variant"])
  |> count()
  |> toFloat()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({variant: r.variant, lead: "samples", _value: r._value}))
union(tables: [byLead, allLeads, samples])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["variant"], columnKey: ["lead"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["all leads"])
